title: Enforce local file-size limits before preverification hashing
impact: The declared 2 GiB cumulative budget does not bound prevalidation archive I/O; oversized receipt and control files are also hashed before their parser limits apply.
requested_change: In the new planner only, precheck actual sizes and supply a maximum to the existing hash helper for archive, receipt and each control file. Add failure-first boundary tests before repair.
other_initial_probes: Real CLI baseline succeeded; coherently rewritten bytes under the original anchor, missing by-hash in a retained fully receipted snapshot, and gzip output larger than 64 MiB all failed closed without an output file.
